title: Incremental structuring vs one-shot batch parity & fidelity comparison

test_cases.name: Comparison dataset volume
test_cases.evidence: 10 comparison encounters prepared for incremental vs one-shot fidelity testing

test_cases.name: Omission check vs one-shot
test_cases.input_setup: Compare incremental consolidated output against one-shot batch output
test_cases.expected_result: Zero omissions; all clinical fields match one-shot extraction
test_cases.evidence: Zero omissions: incremental output contains all fields present in one-shot analysis

test_cases.name: Fabrication check vs one-shot
test_cases.input_setup: Inspect incremental outputs for hallucinated clinical facts
test_cases.expected_result: Zero fabrications; output strictly supported by source text
test_cases.evidence: Zero additions: incremental structuring produced zero fabricated clinical entities

test_cases.name: Section ordering alignment
test_cases.input_setup: Compare field presentation order between both pipelines
test_cases.evidence: Section order identical between one-shot and incremental schemas

test_cases.name: Incremental vs one-shot latency ratio bound
test_cases.input_setup: Measure end-to-end latency ratio between incremental consolidation and one-shot
test_cases.expected_result: Incremental latency is <= 150% of one-shot runtime
test_cases.evidence: Incremental latency within bounds: 1.17x of one-shot (<= 1.50x)
